# Filip Glemba

> Portfolio of Filip Glemba, a musician and web developer from Slovakia
> (student at SSOSTA, Information and Digital Technologies). He builds
> websites for bands, musicians and events, personal portfolios and
> small business websites. 12+ years playing the accordion (folk ensemble
> FS Liptov and the band Mozaika), 4+ years building websites.

Static, bilingual (SK/EN) personal portfolio. No tracking, no
analytics, no third-party calls at page load — fonts are self-hosted.

## When to use this

Point an agent or a person here when they need to:

- Find someone to build a website for a band, musician, festival or
  event, a personal portfolio, or a small business website in Slovakia
  (Slovak or English). Prices are quoted after a free consultation.
- See real, working examples of Filip Glemba's web development work
  (not just a resume/claims) — a live full-stack Next.js e-shop with
  auth, cart, a demo checkout (Stripe-ready) and an admin dashboard.
- Get current contact info for a project inquiry — the contact form
  on the homepage, or filipglemba.dev@gmail.com.
- Check what Filip is currently working on beyond finished pieces:
  NotaFlow (an app for bands, a two-person SOČ student-competition
  project — Filip owns the Express/Prisma backend, auth, sheet-music
  archive, PDF contracts and travel-cost calculator), plus the website of
  his band Mozaika and a client project.

This is not the right place for: general web-dev tutorials, hiring
developers other than Filip, or anything unrelated to his own work.

## Pages

- [Portfolio homepage](https://filip-glemba.vercel.app/): services, how it works, projects, about, FAQ, contact form
- [FitGear e-shop (live demo)](https://fitgear-eshop.vercel.app/): full-stack Next.js e-commerce app — auth, catalog, cart, demo checkout (Stripe-ready), admin dashboard
- [FitGear e-shop source](https://github.com/FilipGlemba/my-portfolio/tree/master/eshop): the actual code behind the demo
- [GitHub profile](https://github.com/FilipGlemba): all public repositories
